notes.title: Policy Update - New Content
notes.content:
[p]Hey employees,[/p][p][/p][p]We have updated our policy effective immediately to grant workers access to a new level in the facility. Just a reminder, [The Company] is not responsible for any injuries caused while on and off the clock.[/p][p][/p][p]Here is the run down on this new policy[/p][list][*][p]New level: [spoiler]Go into Café VOID and discover some weird organic shit... and perhaps Cynthia?[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]Exploration mode: Explore the levels without worrying about the energy count[/p][/*][*][p]Dualsense bug fixes[/p][/*][*][p]New Community Items[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Community Items[/h2][p]We have done an in house study and learned that rewards boost morale and work productivity.
[/p][p]With the results of that study, we used the planned raises we were going to give you to release Steam trading cards, badges, backgrounds, and emoticons. Remember that [The Company] always has your thoughts and feelings in mind when making decisions.[/p][p][/p][p]If you already explored the facility, you may notice some Steam cards already in your inventory. [The Company] has allocated 5 minutes of unpaid time for co-workers to trade to collect all 5 Steam cards.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeeMOA7_oO3hNmCLcRC5p-BcHKNUZy2VQXp7nksmGO7zYkc5KamRH15HFvNJ49OWBZGDjiCaiqFvarbAdSTKtniWe9cj7ZvMQ_9vqaVhE1zclxdiYJhN995NLMEwI395BFmRzjo7g?key=3rFw1rFEZyukBtkHXIeG8A"][/img][/p][list][*][p][The Company][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Policy Change (1.0.0.1) - Slight rebalance in levels
notes.content:
Hey Workers,

HR is instituting a policy change which fixes typos displayed in savecodes, slightly rebalances the difficulty in levels 3 - 6, and more.

Please read below for more information on this change.

[h2]Policy Change[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed typo displayed in savecodes
[*] Difficulty slightly rebalanced in level 3, 4, 5 and 6
[*] “Bedroom” in the Wire Hub changed for clearer progression, now players need to acquire tea first before they can enter the north wing of the level
[*] Fixed bug where players could still control their character during cutscenes if they triggered the cutscene with 0 energy 
[*] Mimics made a bit more noticeable visually
[/list]
- [The Company]
